question: Where and when were the 2025 Juno Awards hosted?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vancouver, March 30**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **54th annual Juno Awards** are scheduled to be held on **March 30, 2025**. This date marks the culmination of **Juno Week**, which features various musical events and showcases.
 
• The prestigious ceremony will take place in **Vancouver**, **British Columbia**. This city was selected to highlight the vibrant music scene of the West Coast. ***Hence, the combination of Vancouver and March 30 is correct.***
 
• The primary venue for the awards broadcast is **Rogers Arena**, a major sports and entertainment hub in **Vancouver**. It has previously hosted numerous high-profile international events and concerts.
 
• It has been officially announced that **Nelly Furtado**, the celebrated Canadian singer-songwriter, will return to host the **2025** ceremony, following her successful hosting stint in **2024**.
 
• The event is produced by Insight Productions
